Answer: C
Reason: The frontal chest X-ray (Figure 1a) clearly shows two distinct nodules indicated by blue arrows: one in the right middle lobe region silhouetting the right heart border and another retrocardiac nodule on the left. This specific finding, combined with the mention of a mosaic attenuation pattern (often seen on CT in such cases), is characteristic of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH).
